additional_info.subject: RE: ID0472139-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / NN 170000049]PowerLoss CRM:02698000734
additional_info.body:
Dear
ID0472139
,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support, I hope this email finds you well.
We have completed the technical analysis of the logs for the charging session you reported. Our data shows that the OCPP experienced a temporary
offline status
during the session.
According to the logs, once the connection was restored, the
OCPP
automatically issued a
'StopTransaction'
command. This is why the session was terminated.
As there was no error flags detected on the unit itself, the charger is functioning as intended. We recommend checking with your
Backend
to verify if this '
OCPP: Send command
' .
Apart from this information, can we help you with anything else?
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
